title: Why I love tennis
instructions: Mia tenisi nasıl sevdiğini anlatıyor. Geçmiş ve şimdiki zamanı ayırt et.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: I started playing tennis when I was eight years old.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: My dad taught me in the park near our house.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Now I play three times a week at a tennis club.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: My coach is called Anna. She is strict, but she is a great teacher.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Last month, I won my first competition. I was so happy!

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Next year, I want to play in the national championship.

script.speaker: mia
script.text: Tennis isn't easy, but it makes me feel strong.

questions.prompt: Who taught Mia to play tennis?
questions.feedback: Ona ilk tenisi babası (my dad) öğretti. Anna şimdiki antrenörü.
questions.evidence: My dad taught me in the park near our house.

questions.prompt: How often does Mia play now?
questions.feedback: Şimdi haftada üç kez (three times a week) oynuyor.
questions.evidence: Now I play three times a week at a tennis club.

options: She played in the national championship.
questions.feedback: Geçen ay ilk yarışmasını kazandı (won). Ulusal şampiyona gelecek yılın hedefi.
questions.evidence: Last month, I won my first competition.
